fusions.name: Draw the Venom
fusions.desc: A bite that deals 16 damage and uses up every affliction on the target, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage and 50% more damage for each one used up. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Spit It Back
fusions.desc: Spits drawn venom in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 10 poison damage with a 60% chance of [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Shed the Bitterness
fusions.desc: Sheds your skin, removing up to 3 poison conditions from you, and you regain 10 health at once.

fusions.name: Counter-Cure
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You have 15% poison resistance and regenerate 0.5 health a second.
